games.name: Arma 3

games.name: ARK: Survival Evolved
games.note: Requires a cooked item folder and matching .mod file. Convert raw packages with ARK's tools.

games.name: Starbound
games.note: PAK mod packages.

games.name: Don't Starve
games.note: Local mod folders. Enable in game.

games.name: Don't Starve Together
games.note: Local client mods. Dedicated server configuration is separate.

games.name: XCOM 2
games.note: Local mod folders. For War of the Chosen choose its XComGame/Mods destination.

games.name: Unturned
games.note: Client content is Steam-managed. Dedicated servers use WorkshopDownloadConfig.json.

games.name: Factorio
games.note: Local ZIP packages only. Factorio does not use Steam Workshop.

games.name: tModLoader
games.note: TMOD packages. Reload mods inside tModLoader after changes.

games.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
games.note: Local SCS/ZIP packages; activate them in the game's Mod Manager.

games.name: American Truck Simulator
games.note: Local SCS/ZIP packages; activate them in the game's Mod Manager.

games.name: Cities: Skylines
games.note: Install manually with the game's content tools; folders vary by content type.

games.name: Space Engineers
games.note: Local mod folders. Add them to the world from the game's mod menu.

games.name: Tabletop Simulator
games.note: JSON saves. The game downloads referenced assets.

games.name: Wallpaper Engine
